resources.string: "Two purposes: (1) Read the pairing code from Android's Wireless debugging dialog, so you do not have to copy a code that expires after two minutes. (2) Let the AI assistant read the screen, tap, type, press keys and take screenshots (Android 11+), enabling device control without ADB or Shizuku.\n\nDSHA does not record your screen in the background. Screen contents are read only when the assistant explicitly requests them, returned directly to the conversation, and are not saved or uploaded separately. Pairing codes are read only during the two minutes after you tap Auto-read pairing code."
"ADB is off. Leave it off if you do not use wireless debugging."

"DeepSeek Harness launcher

Includes a Linux environment. No Termux required.
Installs and starts automatically."
"Repair dsh / npm; settings and conversations are preserved"
"The next page extracts the bundled Linux environment automatically."
"Applies only to the DeepSeek API key entered in this app. Changes are saved immediately. If disabled, enter the key again after restoring. Plugin settings may still contain other credentials."
"Keep the system pairing dialog open. Return to DSHA in split screen and enter the current 6-digit code."

"Allow the assistant and plugins in this DSHA environment to query SMS messages for the current Android user, including numbers, message bodies and verification codes. Preauthorization skips individual confirmations and can be revoked here. Queries only; Android may still deny access. Uses an authorized root or ADB connection. Shizuku does not run SMS queries."

"Allow device directory queries. Root directories, photo folders and Android/data remain read-only. Partition changes, system setting changes and unrecognized commands are blocked. Refresh the complete app list before stopping apps to protect system apps and essential processes. Ordinary download file operations and stopping ordinary user apps can run directly."
"The bundled environment extracts automatically. Add a key to start using it, or install first without a key."
"Tasks continue when you leave this page. Return to see results. Repairs affect only failed items; stopping waits for the current operation to finish safely."
"Start the service on the Start page"
"Enter it in Settings → Configuration, or skip and configure a third-party API in the Web UI later."
"Optional. You can also configure official or third-party APIs and models in the conversation page."

"If the connection drops in the background, allow DSHA to run in the background and reduce battery restrictions. Your device may still suspend it. Before reconnecting, turn on Wireless debugging, then tap Verify connection."
"Start the Web UI, then tap Open to use it in the app."
"Switch between Start, Terminal, Plugins and Settings using the bottom bar."
"Enable ADB in DSHA's Device permissions and keep your phone connected to Wi-Fi."
"While the local Web service is running, devices on the same Wi-Fi can access conversations through port 3081. LAN permission is required. Enable only on trusted networks."
"Backups may contain keys, settings and plugin credentials. Store them securely."
"Safe mode: restore previously enabled third-party plugins"

"Restart the Web service after installing or changing plugins. Supports GitHub, npm and prebuilt ZIP / TAR / TAR.GZ / TGZ plugin packages. Exported packages can be imported into another DSHA installation."
"Use proroot to speed up the container. If your device or a command is incompatible, turn this off to use proot. Save and restart the Web service to apply."
"Force the bundled Gecko browser if the system browser shows a blank page or is incompatible. Otherwise, the app selects a compatible engine automatically. Save and reopen the conversation to apply."
"On a rooted phone, use su directly without ADB pairing. Authorize DSHA in your root manager on first use. Device protection rules always apply."
"Display AI responses and tool status over other apps. After saving, allow display-over-other-apps permission. People nearby may see the output."
"Back up all data, conversations, settings or plugins as needed."
"Enable the device connections and permissions you need. Commands use enabled root access first, then Shizuku, then ADB."
"Connects automatically after authorization; ADB is not required. Rebinds after the service restarts."
"Collect startup failures, crashes and recent output. Downloaded logs are saved to Download/DSHA."

"Regular conversations, plugins and DSHA notifications do not require ADB.

ADB lets the assistant run supported Android device commands, such as inspecting app and system status, reading limited logs and working with files in allowed directories. Every command must still pass DSHA's policy checks. Enabling ADB does not allow silent app installation or removal, system setting changes or firmware flashing.

SMS queries require preauthorization in Settings → Device permissions or confirmation for each query. Screen taps and typing use the screen-control permission below.

Wireless pairing requires Android 11+ Wireless debugging and may be restricted by your device manufacturer. On older versions, use Shizuku where available or continue using features that do not require ADB."
"No terminals\nTap New to open a terminal"
"Changes on this page are saved immediately. Prepare offline dependencies before getting a fresh pairing code so it does not expire while you wait."
"From the system pairing dialog; get a new code if it expires."
"Check all six components and view each result. Repair missing components only as needed."
"Check the runtime environment, certificates and plugin status."
"Tap Verify connection below. Verify again after restarting your phone or turning Wireless debugging off and on."
"Stable receives official releases only. Preview also includes test releases. The app selects the build for your device."
"Add steps to reproduce. Do not include keys or private conversations."
"Keep the screen on during extraction and do not stop the app."
"Use the desktop conversation layout for larger screens. Usually leave this off on phones. Save and reopen the conversation to apply."
"Adjust the overlay background, opacity, line count, font size and display duration. Choose whether to show reasoning and command text."
"Runtime scripts update with the APK. Open this page to check and download app releases."
"Check the selected Stable or Preview channel in the background when the app opens. You decide whether to download an available update."
"Go to Developer options → Wireless debugging, turn it on, then choose Pair device with pairing code."
"Connect to this phone's Android system using Android 11+ Wireless debugging."
"Reset and deletion require confirmation. Back up your data first."
"Extracting the bundled environment for first use. Please wait…"
"Experimental LD_PRELOAD runtime. Switch to proroot or proot if incompatible. Save and restart the Web service to apply."
